topic: Why Do You Only Doubt the Good Things in Your Life?

slides.text: Why do you only doubt the good things in your life?
You never doubt your sadness. You accept it as *fact*.
But when someone says they love you, doubt creeps in.
Doubt is just standing with one foot on each shore.
So doubt the doubt, not the good.
slides.cta: Pick a shore and stand on it today.
